claim: For 2016–2025, Amsterdam’s wettest year in the ERA5 record was 2023, with 1100.7 mm, followed by 2024 with 1042.6 mm. Both exceeded the 1991–2020 annual mean of 777.4 mm.
reason: Source lists wettest years across 1950-2025 overall: 2023 (1100.7) and 2024 (1042.6) are top, but the claim restricts to 2016-2025; the source does not give a 2016-2025 ranking. Mean 777.4 mm for 1991-2020 is stated.
